prompt:
A music-video still on a mansion lawn at golden late afternoon, shot from a low angle with a 24mm lens close behind SILVER. SILVER, the tall one, stands in the lower right foreground in an oxblood-red suit and bow tie, black leather gloves, arms folded, his head tipped back and turned three-quarters toward camera: a seamless hand-knitted silver-grey rib wool hood covers his whole head and neck, tucked into a turned-up collar, smooth knit where the face would be, a thin crimson chain-stitched ring outlining the face, and one small rounded red felt triangle sewn high over his right eye, on the left side of the picture. Above him a huge hot-air balloon stitched together from thousands of green banknotes swells as it inflates, burners roaring orange. In its wicker basket a pair of rich couples in furs and boaters wave. A white-columned mansion and clipped hedges behind. Warm low sun from the right, long shadows, fine grain.

Thanks.
